Everything works now. `npm test` passes — Amabie verified the committed candidate from outside (`POST-PROOF PASS`) and fast-forwarded `main` to it, so no need to re-run the suite in the base.

- `tests/regression.test.js` — new: three tests (negatives mixed in, all-negative list, negative average) that all fail against the old implementation and pass against the fix, added to satisfy Amabie's regression-evidence obligation.

Skipped: touching `largest()` (already correct); candidate cleanup — run `amabie isolate --remove sum-fix` when you're done with the record.
